name: Château Margaux Premier Grand Cru Classé

tasting_notes.nose: Vibrant violet florals, crushed blackberries, graphite, and toasted French oak.
tasting_notes.palate: Silky yet structured cassis, dark plum, cigar box, and black truffle complexity.
tasting_notes.finish: Endless, aristocratic finish with lingering mineral and cedar undertones.

pairing: Prime dry-aged ribeye, roast venison, or aged Comté cheese.

name: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti Grand Cru

tasting_notes.nose: Wild rose petals, spiced cherry, sous-bois (forest floor), and exotic tea leaves.
tasting_notes.palate: Weightless intensity, wild strawberries, orange peel, and pure velvet tannins.
tasting_notes.finish: Ethereal, hauntingly persistent with chalky limestone minerality.

pairing: Roast duck breast with cherry reduction, pheasant, or Périgord black truffles.

name: Opus One Proprietary Red Blend

tasting_notes.nose: Fresh black cherry, espresso crema, dark cocoa, and dried bay leaf.
tasting_notes.palate: Rich, opulent layers of ripe blueberry, vanilla bean, and polished tannins.
tasting_notes.finish: Long, warm harmonic finish with notes of mocha and dark spices.

pairing: Charcoal grilled tomahawk steak, rosemary lamb racks.

name: Biondi-Santi Brunello di Montalcino Riserva

tasting_notes.nose: Sour cherry, blood orange, leather, dried oregano, and crushed stone.
tasting_notes.palate: Laser-focused acidity carrying tart red fruit, dark earth, and firm tannins.
tasting_notes.finish: Extremely dry, austere, noble, and endlessly evolving in the glass.

pairing: Wild boar ragù, Florentine T-bone steak, Parmigiano-Reggiano 36 months.

name: Dom Pérignon Vintage Champagne Brut

tasting_notes.nose: Mirabelle plum, fresh brioche, roasted almonds, and white smoke.
tasting_notes.palate: Chiseled effervescence, crystalline citrus, salinity, and creaminess.
tasting_notes.finish: Taut, mineral-driven finish vibrating with clean vitality.

pairing: Beluga caviar, freshly shucked oysters, butter-poached lobster.

name: The Macallan 18 Year Double Cask Single Malt

tasting_notes.nose: Dried fruit, ginger, toffee, rich orange oil, and seasoned oak spice.
tasting_notes.palate: Rich sultanas, warm cinnamon, nutmeg, treacle, and caramelized citrus.
tasting_notes.finish: Lingering oak spice balanced with warm wood smoke and sweet orange.

pairing: Dark single-origin chocolate (70%+), artisanal candied ginger.

name: Lagavulin 16 Year Islay Single Malt Scotch

tasting_notes.nose: Intense peat smoke, iodine, seaweed, lapsang souchong tea, and sweet dates.
tasting_notes.palate: Dry peat smoke filling the mouth with gentle sweetness, sea salt, and malt.
tasting_notes.finish: Tremendously long, warming peat finish with peppery smoke and fig sweetness.

pairing: Smoked oysters, blue Stilton cheese, charcuterie.

name: Yamazaki 18 Year Japanese Single Malt

tasting_notes.nose: Mizunara Japanese oak, raisin, apricot, cafe au lait, and sandalwood.
tasting_notes.palate: Silky blackberry, strawberry jam, dark chocolate, and spicy incense.
tasting_notes.finish: Enthralling long finish with cedar, pipe tobacco, and dried fruit.

pairing: Wagyu beef tataki, unagi kabayaki, dried persimmons.

name: Pappy Van Winkle Family Reserve 15 Year

tasting_notes.nose: Caramelized brown sugar, charred oak, toasted pecans, and ripe cherries.
tasting_notes.palate: Heavy wheated viscosity, vanilla extract, leather, and dark honey.
tasting_notes.finish: Monumental warm spice fade with decadent butterscotch and aged wood.

pairing: Pecan pie with bourbon glaze, aged farmhouse cheddar.

name: Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Botanical Gin

tasting_notes.nose: Crisp pine juniper, citrus verbena, lingonberries, and floral cardamom.
tasting_notes.palate: Unprecedented botanical tapestry of 47 ingredients, herbal depth, and pepper.
tasting_notes.finish: Harmonious lingering pine and complex citrus oils.

pairing: Artisanal Mediterranean tonic, fresh grapefruit peel, rosemary sprig.

name: Clase Azul Reposado Artisanal Tequila

tasting_notes.nose: Cooked blue agave, hazelnut, vanilla bean, and candied orange peel.
tasting_notes.palate: Silky smooth agave honey, toasted wood, banana, and subtle cinnamon.
tasting_notes.finish: Sweet, velvety finish with toasted oak and warm agave.

pairing: Ceviche with mango, Mexican dark chocolate with chili.

name: Del Maguey Pechuga Ancestral Mezcal

tasting_notes.nose: Smoked agave, ripe plantain, roasted plums, anise, and savoury mountain air.
tasting_notes.palate: Triple-distilled through chicken breast, wild mountain fruits, sea salt, and smoke.
tasting_notes.finish: Complex, savoury, crystalline and gently warming.

pairing: Oaxacan black mole with turkey, grilled grasshoppers (chapulines).

name: Tesseron Lot No. 29 Exception XO Cognac

tasting_notes.nose: Rancio charentais, fig jam, cigar humidor, cocoa, and white truffles.
tasting_notes.palate: Aged for over three generations in Limousin oak; silky dried apricots and spices.

pairing: Cuban Cohiba Behike cigar, espresso ristretto.

name: Diplomático Ambassador Selection Rum

tasting_notes.nose: Port wine richness, dried prunes, dark molasses, cinnamon, and toasted wood.
tasting_notes.palate: Finished in Pedro Ximenez sherry butts; unctuous caramel, raisins, and dark cocoa.
tasting_notes.finish: Rich, warming, sweet smoke and dark espresso.

pairing: Crème brûlée, aged Manchego with quince paste.

name: Giacomo Conterno Barolo Monfortino Riserva

tasting_notes.nose: Tar and roses, macerated cherries, licorice, mint, and white Alba truffle.
tasting_notes.palate: Colossal structure, tensile Nebbiolo tannins with profound depth of savory fruit.
tasting_notes.finish: Immense architectural finish that lingers for minutes.

pairing: Tajarin pasta with shaved white Alba truffle, braised beef in Barolo.

name: Château d'Yquem Premier Cru Supérieur

tasting_notes.nose: Intoxicating layers of dried apricot, orange blossom, white peach, acacia honey, saffron, and candied ginger.
tasting_notes.palate: Astonishing opulence balanced by electrifying botrytis acidity; notes of crème brûlée, marmalade, and toasted marzipan.
tasting_notes.finish: Peerless aristocratic length carrying vibrant candied citrus peel and pure liquid honeycomb.

pairing: Seared Hudson Valley foie gras, artisanal Roquefort, or glazed stone fruit tart.
